notes.subject: mũceraani ũrĩa atũũraga hamwe na inywe
notes.rationale: Hebrew repeats verb גור — 'the sojourner who sojourneth'; Gĩkũyũ renders second occurrence as 'who dwells with you' to avoid repetition

notes.subject: mũndũ
notes.rationale: Hebrew לאזרח has no 'person'; Gĩkũyũ needs the noun head

notes.subject: גר/הגר
notes.rationale: root repetition ger hagur — stranger/who-sojourns, softened in Gĩkũyũ

translation: Tora ĩmwe nĩĩgĩkũo kũ mũndũ ũrĩa aciarĩtwo bũrũri-inĩ ũcio, na kũ mũceraani ũrĩa atũũraga hamwe na inywe.

tokens.gloss: kũ mũndũ ũrĩa aciarĩtwo bũrũri-inĩ ũcio
